blocks.text: Yesterday, Michael Hulett of The Hulett Collection ran the Philadelphia Marathon. The day before, he shared this text, accompanied by a selection of photographs centered on the theme of running.
Tomorrow morning I’ll join 20,000 other runners in the cold and early dawn for the Philadelphia Marathon. It’s my first, though I’ve been dabbling in long distance running for the past few years.

I’ve been thinking about what people don’t always see: the early morning runs, the hours away from family, the injuries and setbacks. It’s hard to believe I’ve been training since July for something that will be over in a matter of hours.

But I suppose it was never just about the race. It’s the process, the hardships, and the pushing of your limits to get here that make the journey magical. (Though I’ll admit, getting to tell everyone you’re training for a marathon is gratifying in its own way.)
With that, I’m leaving you with a selection of images that make me think of the different parts of the race. And if you’d like to follow me along the course, my bib number is 6611.
